mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month is a strong signal of economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors favor equities in a low-inflation, low-interest-rate environment.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% each in a single month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic fundamentals, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors are confident in the overall economic health.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 is high, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
